name: Clonmacnoise & the Midlands
summary: A sixth-century monastic city of round towers and high crosses on a bend of the Shannon, in the flat green middle of Ireland that most itineraries skip on their way west. Pair it with a whiskey stop in Kilbeggan and you've made a day of the road itself.
highlights: The high crosses of Clonmacnoise with the Shannon behind them
Kilbeggan's old distillery, still smelling of barley
Watching the river traffic from Athlone's bridge
